profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Sheer Health | Full Stack
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer, I thrive at the intersection of curiosity, problem-solving, and adaptability. I bring a generalist mindset that enables me to wear many hats—whether it's architecting robust APIs, building end-to-end applications, managing cloud infrastructure, or mentoring engineers. I am committed to building effective systems that deliver impact.

At Disney, I’ve owned key initiatives within our high-scale Ad Platform infrastructure. I’ve architected a unified API to standardize on cross-cutting concerns such as infrastructure, deployments, authorizations, and observability for all 700+ applications in our platform. I’ve collaborated cross-functionally on a solution for one-click orchestration of cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes deployments, enabling rapid creation of large end-to-end environments with 100+ microservices in minutes.

Alongside technical impact, I’ve had the opportunity to be an Interim Engineering Manager, driving initiatives, mentoring engineers, and continuously pushing for improvements within our organization.

Driven by impact, I constantly seek opportunities to grow, mentor others, and deliver meaningful solutions. If you’re looking for someone who fits this description, let’s connect!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Monica, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Projects | Backend & Full Stack
• Architected a unified API to seamlessly manage all 700+ applications in the Ad Platform, standardizing on cross-cutting concerns (infrastructure, deployments, authorization, and observability)
• Developed a solution for one-click orchestration of cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes deployments, enabling rapid creation of large end-to-end environments with 100+ microservices in minutes
• Built a custom Terraform Provider to efficiently manage shared IAM resources for all 700+ applications, ensuring the platform stayed within service quotas to maintain a single production AWS account
• Pioneered an organization-wide CLI that transformed workflows for 500+ developers, enabling secure local development by automating IAM role assumption and temporary database credential generation
• Implemented a Live TV stream analyzer to evaluate SCTE-35 marker placement in Addressable Ads, enabling the business to quickly address frame-by-frame quality concerns and enhance the overall Ads Experience
• Engineered a platform-wide automated regression testing pipeline to support Continuous Delivery, eliminating manual testing needs for onboarded teams and saving developers 1+ days per sprint on average

Projects | Infrastructure
• Architected an authentication and authorization system to securely expose critical Ad Ingestion APIs to external partners through a single domain (impacting revenue of $1B+), enabling granular access control for individual routes
• Engineered a Kubernetes scaling solution that integrated CloudWatch with Istio RPM metrics, enabling real-time and preset scaling for high-traffic events, such as March Madness
• Introduced features in Istio to improve mesh reliability at scale (700+ applications, 1M+ RPS per cluster)

Leadership & Collaboration
• Served as Interim Engineering Manager for a quarter, mentored 8 engineers within the organization, promoted best practices, and led large-scale cloud architecture reviews/presentations
positions.insights: Skills: Containerization · TypeScript · Spinnaker · Helm (Software) · Amazon EKS · Go (Programming Language) · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Datadog · Next.js · SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Released multiple Terraform modules for AWS resources (such as Lambda, DynamoDB, and Cognito) alongside Sentinel policy checks to ensure tagging compliance throughout the platform
• Designed a Terraform module and platform-wide deployment pipelines for all AWS Lambda serverless functions, allowing for seamless self-service and development
• Developed a Slack bot to assist in the automation of audit reports, announcements, and critical alerts to team Slack channels, enhancing platform observability and communication
positions.insights: Skills: Containerization · TypeScript · Spinnaker · Helm (Software) · Amazon EKS · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Datadog · Next.js · SQL

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Supported and secured the platform’s mission-critical Jenkins server, and implemented an automated backup restoration process that utilized SaltStack technology, Bash, and redundant backups to nearly eliminate downtime
• Migrated a Java based microservice (built with Gradle) to a new CI/CD pipeline and AWS account for a proof of concept that required modification of platform libraries, Terraform, and creation of a multi-stage Docker build
• Developed an API to simplify AWS IAM policy generation through integration with Terraform, and presented on IAM core
principles to encourage adoption of best practices for SOX compliance
• Integrated Datadog with existing AWS Lambda infrastructure for logging and custom metrics
positions.insights: Skills: Containerization · Spinnaker · Helm (Software) · Amazon EKS · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Datadog · Next.js · SQL

positions.title: Enterprise Analytics Intern
positions.description:
Enhanced an ML-based predictive analytics pipeline by creating an internal web application that utilizes department APIs to perform predictions on existing insurance members. Increased predictive model accessibility for non-programmer analysts and simplified the process for outreach teams to potentially help members with predicted health conditions.

•	Performed full-stack development with Flask (Python), ReactJS & d3 & jQuery (JavaScript), HTML5, CSS3/SASS, SQL
•	Provided detailed workflow recommendations to the Actuarial Department (Visual Studio Code, Jupyter & iPython, Bash)
•	Presented work to the Chief Architect, Data Science VP, and Business Intelligence Director to successfully guarantee business-side support for future development

company.name: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Massachusetts

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
As a University of Michigan Transportation Research Institute research assistant, implemented & debugged the "Simulation and Optimization of Dynamic & High-Occupancy Ridesharing" project. 

• Investigated the transportation network and taxi supply/demand patterns of Manhattan, NYC
• Analyzed research papers to implement, compare, and test (unit & integration testing) their underlying travel time estimation algorithms in Python
• Applied object-oriented methodology to restructure a procedurally designed ridesharing simulator for the dynamic linear programming-based matching of multiple passengers to multiple vehicles

positions.title: Cybersecurity & Machine Learning Intern
positions.description:
Supplemented the cybersecurity infrastructure of Seceon Open Threat Management (OTM) Platform with a product feature responsible for differentiating and flagging malicious botnets in network traffic.

•	Developed, containerized, and deployed a multi-module Python application that utilized Random Forest (supervised ML) to inspect network traffic and flag malicious botnets
•	Integrated program with existing company infrastructure and gained experience with CentOS, Docker, Elasticsearch, Ansible, and Wireshark
•	Performed extensive data collection & wrangling, feature selection testing and model generation, and created a daemon to automate the model re-training process from growing datasets and packet captures

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: As part of the Behavioral Health Outpatient Automation project team, studied the system architecture, business requirements, and technical design. Performed documentation and wrote & presented a white-paper for the Vice President of IT. Gained exposure to back-end technologies such as C# .NET and MS SQL, and the software development lifecycle (along with change management and QA).
